name: Vertex Securities Limited
about: Vertex Securities Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides brokerage services for equity, equity derivatives, currency derivatives, and commodities in India. It also provides mutual funds, NCDs and bonds, and insurance products; and IPO services. In addition, the company offers online mutual funds, insurance support, and account opening services. It provides its services through its network of branches and franchisees. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Mumbai, India. Vertex Securities Limited is a subsidiary of Transwarranty Finance Limited.
